newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's wheat futures mainly firm on weather.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's wheat futures mainly firm on weather.

text.p: Hungary's milling wheat futures closed mixed but rose for the most active months on a forecast of hot weather for this week, traders said.
"(Meteorologists) forecast 30 to 31 grades (Celsius) for this week," said Antal Szoke of Agrimpex. "That may be bad for wheat."

Traders added that grains futures turnover on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) was 102.6 million forints on Monday, down from 108.3 million forints on Friday, and speculation could move the prices easily.
Milling wheat futures accounted for 162 lots of the total turnover of 202 lots in the BCE's grains sections, with the October and December maturities trading the most actively.
The price of both maturities was settled higher by 400 forints, with the October milling wheat finishing at 25,890 forints and the December maturity closing at 26,500.
Trade in other grains on the BCE was inactive.
